fields.System.Title: INB-208 — Confirm a receipt and create stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want to confirm a receipt, so that the stock becomes visible
in the system and can be put away and sold.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given all lines counted, when I confirm, then stock is created in the receiving
  • location, a movement exists per line, the receipt status becomes confirmed, and a putaway
  • task exists per line.
  • - Given a batch-tracked line with no batch, then the whole confirm is rejected and
  • nothing is created.
  • - Given the confirm succeeds, then an inbound.receipt_confirmed event is in the
  • outbox.
  • - Given the database fails partway, then stock, movements, receipt status, and tasks are
  • all rolled back together.
  • - Given an already-confirmed receipt, then confirming again is rejected as an invalid
  • state transition.
  • - Given each created movement, then its from-location is VIRT-SUPPLIER.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, inventory |
| Tables | receipt, receipt_line, stock_balance, stock_movement, putaway_task, outbox |
| Risks | Partial commit ([doc 09 §2.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); tasks created before commit ([doc 04 §3.4](../../../docs/04-modules.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · rollback · event assertion · invariant |
